{{Top}}
'''Espirion''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] that included the legendary [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Handi]]. During the rule of the [[Eternal Empire]], researchers claimed to have discovered Handi's lost resting place.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Guardian of Espirion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Espirion species was created for ''[[Star Wars: Princess Leia]]'', a [[canon]] comic miniseries published in [[2015]]. They were later referenced in the crew skill mission "Guardian of Espirion" in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']], the [[2016]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the game is part of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.
